lines: Jeet le jaaye

couplets.en: Let someone with luck on their side win me.

lines: Jeet le jaaye koi mujhko naseebon wala

couplets.en: Let some lucky soul win what life has staked.

couplets.en: Life has wagered me, and a lamp still burns in the dark.

lines: Jaane kab dil mein koi

lines: Imtihaan aur mere zabt ka tum kya loge

couplets.en: How else will you test my restraint, when I have hidden even my heartbeat?

lines: Dil tha ik shola, magar beet gaye din woh, Qateel
couplets.en: The heart was once a flame, Qateel, and those days are gone.

couplets.en: The heart's fire is long gone, Qateel, so why stir the ashes now?
